# Vanilla Project Starter

A neutral starting point for a new product that can adopt any complete Kit visual system without rebuilding its product logic or journeys.

## Included

- Four working starting shapes: product app, landing page, shop, and publication.
- A full light and dark Vanilla foundation.
- Framework-free shared interface pieces.
- One explicit record of what the product owns and what the visual kit owns.
- Shared project memory for Claude Code, Codex, and future collaborators.

## First Product Decision

Replace the intentionally undefined product purpose in `docs/BRAIN.md` before product-specific work begins. Keep semantic Kit roles in presentation code and keep product routes, data, behavior, copy, permissions, and journeys outside the visual kit.

## Checks

Open `index.html`, use every project-type choice, switch visual kits, switch light and dark, submit the sample form, and open and close the sample dialog. Verify phone and desktop layouts without horizontal page overflow.

# Agent Instructions — Vanilla Project Starter

## Project State

- This is a new product created from the Vanilla Project Starter.
- `docs/BRAIN.md` is the durable source of current product truth.
- `docs/START_HERE.md` routes every task to the smallest relevant context.
- The product purpose is intentionally undefined until the owner writes the first brief.

## Product And Kit Boundary

- The product owns routes, data, behavior, content, journeys, persistence, permissions, and business rules.
- The active visual kit owns tokens, typography, component expression, interaction states, responsive rules, motion, density, and visual hierarchy.
- Use semantic Kit roles. Do not add raw product-shell colors, shadows, radii, font families, or control sizes.
- A kit swap changes presentation. It does not silently replace product structure or behavior.
- Repair spacing, overlap, overflow, unreachable controls, and accessibility defects before judging a replacement kit.

## Working Rules

- Read `docs/BRAIN.md` and `docs/START_HERE.md` before changing the product.
- Preserve unrelated work and inspect repository state before editing.
- Keep controls at least 44 pixels, focus visible, motion purposeful, and reduced motion still.
- Use solid surfaces. No glass, decorative translucency, glow, ambient blobs, or resting loops.
- Run the project's real checks before claiming success.
- Update `docs/BRAIN.md` when durable truth changes and append `docs/LEDGER.md` after meaningful work.
Read and follow `AGENTS.md` as the canonical project instructions. Then read `docs/BRAIN.md` and `docs/START_HERE.md`.

# Project Brain

## Purpose

The product purpose is not defined yet. The first product task is to replace this statement with the real user, problem, outcome, and success measure before implementation expands.

## Current State

- The project starts from the Vanilla visual system in light and dark.
- Product presentation uses semantic Kit roles and framework-free shared pieces.
- App, landing, shop, and content examples demonstrate possible starting shapes; none is product authority until selected by the owner.
- The project is ready for a future visual kit swap without changing product-owned routes, data, behavior, content, journeys, persistence, or permissions.

## Durable Decisions

- Vanilla is the neutral starting system, not permanent product identity.
- The product/kit ownership boundary in `kit-manifest.json` is binding.
- Product-specific presentation must not bypass semantic Kit roles with raw visual values.
- Every release requires responsive, keyboard, focus, touch-target, reduced-motion, console, and production-build proof.

## Current Priority

Define the real product brief, choose one starting shape that fits its primary journey, and remove the unused examples rather than carrying speculative pages forward.

## Sources Of Truth

- Agent behavior: `AGENTS.md`
- Product truth: `docs/BRAIN.md`
- Task routing: `docs/START_HERE.md`
- Work history: `docs/LEDGER.md`
- Active visual-system contract: `kit-manifest.json`

# Start Here

Read `../AGENTS.md`, then `BRAIN.md`.

## Choose The Smallest Relevant Context

- Product purpose or current state: `BRAIN.md`
- Visual-system ownership or a future kit swap: `../kit-manifest.json`
- Recent work and proof: `LEDGER.md`
- Human overview: `../README.md`

## First Session

Replace the undefined purpose in `BRAIN.md` with the actual user, problem, intended outcome, primary journey, recovery path, and the evidence that will prove the product works.

# Agent Ledger

## Project Birth — Vanilla Starter

- Starting state: new project with no product-specific behavior or durable user data.
- Foundation: complete Vanilla visual system with light and dark modes.
- Starting shapes: app, landing, shop, and content examples.
- Ownership: product behavior and journeys remain separate from the visual kit.
- Agent context: AGENTS, Claude router, project brain, start-here guide, and append-only work ledger are present.
- Next action: define the real product purpose and select the one starting shape its primary journey requires.
